policy.rule: weight 1/N long on every member at every weekly deadline, so the coordinator restores equal weights each week

registered futures defaults; walk the closed-bar signals from the first frozen bar to the deadline bar: signal 1 enters long, signal -1 exits a long (the strategy registers short_entries=False, so -1 never opens a short); weight = position / N
registered futures defaults (allow_short true); weight = signed position column at the deadline bar / N
